pay.title: Pay a bill
pay.intro: Pay your syndicate bills and annual subscriptions electronically through eFAWATEERcom, Jordan's national e-payment service. No account on this portal is required.
pay.efawateercomBody: The syndicate is a registered biller on eFAWATEERcom. Pay from your bank's app or website, an eFAWATEERcom kiosk, or the eFAWATEERcom app.
pay.step1: Open your bank app or the eFAWATEERcom service and choose “Pay bills”.
pay.step2: Under the “Associations & Unions” category, select the Syndicate of Surveying Office Owners.
pay.step3: Enter your membership number or the invoice reference from the syndicate.
pay.step4: Review the amount, confirm, and keep the eFAWATEERcom receipt.
pay.need1: Your membership number, or the invoice reference printed on the bill from the syndicate.
pay.need2: A Jordanian bank account or card enrolled with eFAWATEERcom.
pay.onboardingTitle: Instant in-portal payment is on the way
pay.onboardingBody: Viewing and paying an invoice directly on this page will switch on once the syndicate's eFAWATEERcom biller account is fully activated. Until then, please use the eFAWATEERcom channels above.
pay.referenceNote: Have an invoice reference? You'll enter that number in eFAWATEERcom to find and settle your bill.
